app_fee.value: Nonresident international applicants pay $100 (U.S. citizens and permanent residents pay $75).
app_fee.quote: Degree-seeking applicants pay a non-refundable application processing fee of $75 (U.S. citizens and permanent residents) or $100 (nonresident internationals)

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School waives the fee only for a few groups: Missouri Pell Grant recipients, certain Missouri service-program members and honorably discharged veterans. International applicants are not on that list; some programs may pay it.
fee_waiver.quote: The Graduate School will waive the application fee for the following applicant groups | Pell Grant recipients (within the past five years) who are Missouri residents

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no GRE rule for PhD applicants; each program sets its own (see program records).

toefl_min.value: Minimum total TOEFL iBT score of 80 on the 0-120 scale, with subsection minimums of 17; some programs require more.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic overall band of 6.5, with no subsection below 6; some programs require more.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the Graduate School's list of recognized English-speaking countries, and an Indian degree does not count as an exemption, so a TOEFL or IELTS score is required.
english_waiver.quote: Hold a degree from an institution in a recognized English-speaking country | Are a citizen or legal resident of a recognized English-speaking country

notes: Program-level English minimums are on the Graduate School table (Biological Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Statistics and others); see those program records. Chemistry fee waiver is for US citizens and permanent residents only.
